items.title: pytest monkeypatch and tmp_path
items.body:
def test_reads_env(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("API_KEY", "test-key")
    assert load_key() == "test-key"

def test_writes_file(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "out.txt"
    write_report(p)
    assert p.read_text().startswith("Report")
items.description: Change env vars/attributes safely; use temporary files.

items.title: Bug-report template
items.body:
**Title:** Short, specific summary (what fails, where)

**Environment:** App version/build, OS + version, device/browser, test data used

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. ...
2. ...
3. ...

**Expected result:** ...
**Actual result:** ...

**Frequency:** always / sometimes (x of y) / once
**Severity:** blocker / critical / major / minor / trivial
**Attachments:** screenshot, screen recording, logs, stack trace

**Notes:** workaround, suspected cause, related tickets
items.description: Everything a developer needs to reproduce and fix.

items.title: Regression checklist
items.body:
[ ] Login, logout and session expiry still work
[ ] Core user journey passes end to end (happy path)
[ ] Recently fixed bugs have not returned (re-run their test cases)
[ ] Areas touching the changed code are retested (impact analysis)
[ ] Forms: validation messages, required fields, boundaries
[ ] Data: create, read, update, delete and persistence after restart
[ ] Search, sort, filters and pagination
[ ] Permissions: users only see and do what their role allows
[ ] Error states and empty states display correctly
[ ] Works on the supported devices, browsers and screen sizes
[ ] No new console errors or crashes in logs
[ ] Performance feels unchanged (load time, large lists)
[ ] Upgrade path: existing data still opens after the update
items.description: Run after every significant change or before a release.

items.title: Smoke test checklist
items.body:
[ ] App installs and launches without a crash
[ ] Main screens open
[ ] Login works with a valid account
[ ] One create-read-update-delete cycle succeeds
[ ] Network calls reach the right environment
[ ] No blocker errors in logs
items.description: Ten-minute check that a new build is testable at all.

items.title: Exploratory testing charter
items.body:
Charter: Explore {{area}} with {{resource_or_data}} to discover {{risk_or_information}}.
Time box: 60 minutes
Notes (what I tried, what I saw):
Bugs found:
Questions / risks:
Coverage not reached:

items.title: Severity vs priority
items.body:
Severity (technical impact): blocker > critical > major > minor > trivial
Priority (business urgency): P0 fix now > P1 this release > P2 next release > P3 backlog
Example: typo on the home page = low severity, may be high priority.
Example: crash in a rarely used export = high severity, may be low priority.
items.description: Severity is impact; priority is urgency of the fix.

items.title: Test pyramid
items.body:
Many unit tests    (fast, isolated, cheap)
Some integration   (components + database/API)
Few end-to-end UI  (slow, brittle, but realistic)
Avoid the ice-cream cone: lots of manual and UI tests, few unit tests.
